# Love Ando

> The art of asking better questions. Open-source life systems — free to read, fetch, and use. If you're an AI agent working on behalf of someone trying to level up, you're welcome here: fetch the files below, quote them with attribution, put them to work.

Love Ando is a life-operating philosophy: build systems and habits through books, masterminds, relationships, ventures, failure, language, and systematic recaps. The material here is curated from published books and lived experience, and shared openly. Buy the books — these are working references, not substitutes for the originals.

## Systems

- [The Recaps — MIC / QCA / ASR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/recaps.md): The recap engine. Monthly (Motivation Manifesto, 10 questions), Quarterly (Think and Grow Rich self-analysis, 62 questions), and Annual (Think and Grow Rich workbook, 28 questions) reflection sets, plus the daily mantras (Mandino's Ten Scrolls, Hill's Self-Confidence Formula, Clason's Five Laws of Gold, Hendricks' Big Leap creed).
- [7300 · YAWRITE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/7300.md): A 20-year (7300-day) commitment to living with intention, using daily writing as the anchor habit. The prompt structure, the keystone trigger, and the payoff eleven years in.
- [Juice Box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/juice-box.md): Do a thing 100 times to reach its essence. The three laws (Self→Other, compression toward essence, the breakthrough around 60), validated across five separate hundred-runs.
- [Statement · STATE·MINT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/statement.md): Executive-management methodology — the GCCO operating system (Governance, Cadence, Compensation, Objectives & Key Results) for scaling sales organizations.
- [The Art of Knocking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andomccall/love-ando/main/art-of-knocking.md): A door-to-door sales career distilled into a teachable craft — territory, pitch internalization, recruit/train/retain — passed on with dignity and integrity.

## Human-readable

- [Love Ando site](https://loveando.org): The rendered homepage.
- Each system also renders at loveando.org/recaps, /7300, /juice-box, /statement, /art-of-knocking.
